notes.note: Websites now need permission before connecting to devices on the local network or to apps and services on the device. [Learn more](https://support.mozilla.org/kb/control-personal-device-local-network-permissions-firefox-android)
Fixed web addresses containing non-Latin characters appearing as encoded text instead of in readable form in the address bar and elsewhere in the app.
Fixed web addresses containing spaces, such as those from scanned QR codes, being searched for instead of opened.
Fixed double-tapping or long-pressing a word to select it, and tapping to place the cursor, not working near the cursor in text fields.
